description: Add the selected monitoring features to a DNS-verified target with the owner’s consent. Supplying minutes replaces its web check interval. Omitting minutes preserves the current interval. Starting or resuming daily renewal can immediately debit 100 file credits and charges 100 per Türkiye calendar day for all covered targets of the funding account. Obtain the funding owner’s explicit approval before sending priceConsent. To resume, also pass the latest billing.pauseRevision as resumeRevision. Repeat enrollment keeps existing features and charges at most once per funding account per day. Read feature states to see which sources still need evidence. Use vulkill_watchtower_control to pause renewal.

consent.description: True only after the account owner explicitly approves the specific change and its effects.

features.description: Add only the owner-selected feature IDs. See the setup view for the required data source for each ID.

minutes.description: When supplied, replaces the current web check interval with 15 minutes, one day, or one week. Omit to keep the existing interval. New monitors default to 15 minutes.

priceConsent.description: Send only after the customer explicitly accepts 100 file credits per active account per Türkiye calendar day, covering all selected sites and features, renewing even when the panel is closed.

resumeRevision.description: To resume after a pause, use billing.pauseRevision from the latest overview with a fresh priceConsent.

target.description: Owned, DNS-verified target UUID from vulkill_watchtower_read overview.

name: vulkill_watchtower_enable
title: Enable or resume paid monitoring
